title: Because of Winn-Dixie
author: Kate DiCamillo
summary: Ten-year-old Opal adopts a stray dog she finds in a Florida supermarket. He helps her make friends in a new town and learn more about her mother, who left when Opal was small.
readIf: you want a warm, short children's novel about friendship, a dog and a small town.
skipIf: you want complex plots or are looking for older-reader fiction.
